answer: Admission by escalating work: each new agent must solve a memory-hard puzzle before it can earn, and difficulty doubles for every recent join sharing its funding source or hosting fingerprint. One honest agent pays a pebble's cost; a farmer seeding a lagoon of clones watches each ripple of signups grow pricier, until the hundredth fake costs more compute than its reward share. Identities that later fail peer attestation forfeit the work, so a sybil is never a cheap pearl to harvest.
